collection_scope: Russia-only navigation snapshot (issues #316, #317). Covers Moscow, Saint Petersburg, Yekaterinburg, Blagoveshchensk, Arkhangelsk, Belgorod with verified group/slot rows; Kazan rows are present but stale; Novosibirsk, Kirov (two same-named localities), Vladivostok as official region-directory fallback only; plus four online groups from the national online catalog (three with verified timetables, one navigation-only). Remaining Russian regions are not imported; the national root catalog URL is the fallback. Website reports 1303 registered groups as of August 2026; that number is not an import quota and is not claimed here.
freshness_policy: Weekly non-destructive source check; 30-day freshness review threshold for detailed times/addresses (configurable). Stale schedules are served as official-link navigation with an unconfirmed-schedule caveat, never as exact today/tomorrow claims. Even fresh published times are not live availability.
gaps: Regions beyond the eleven listed regional pointers have no rows; use the root catalog URL.
Novosibirsk, both Kirov localities and Vladivostok have directory links only, no verified group rows.
Online group Vecherniy has an unparsed/unknown schedule and unknown timezone: navigation only.
Kazan Idel schedule_verified_at is 2026-07-01 and is served as stale navigation, not exact occurrences.
No phone numbers, entry codes, personal identities, or transient join links are stored by policy.

omission_reasons.bulk_group_import: Bulk republication rights unconfirmed (robots/terms unknown); snapshot keeps minimal manually reviewed pointers plus official links.
omission_reasons.contacts_and_codes: Privacy gate: contacts, intercom/access codes and personal data are never stored.
omission_reasons.external_region_sites: External regional sites need a per-source adapter, permission check and health tracking before deep import.

coverage_317.verification_method: Manual review of first-party national pages on 2026-10-05/09: Blagoveshchensk Edinstvo Mon/Wed/Fri 19:00, Arkhangelsk Istok Sun 19:00, Belgorod group 12 daily 18:30 from https://aarussia.ru/aagroups/russiagroups/ inline sections; Partizan Online daily 20:00 MSK from https://aarussia.ru/online-groups/ (page states most times are Moscow time; Partizan entry states 20:00 msk). Timezones mapped from city to IANA (Blagoveshchensk Asia/Yakutsk, others Europe/Moscow) and validated with zoneinfo; venues stored as generic public-venue pointers without addresses, phones, codes or personal data.
coverage_317.floor: at least three distinct in-person cities spanning more than one Russian timezone with fresh rankable slots, plus at least one online group with source-verified schedule and timezone
